title: Fixed Four Port Crossrail and Open Flange Channels
description: One complete newly authored fixed four-port railway crossing appearance. Two perpendicular through routes form a single connected foot/web/head assembly above a common diagonal timber-sleeper group. Rail volumes of the same height layer are genuinely fused at their intersections, while separate true inside-flange channels remove the crossing head and upper web material at all four rail intersections. All four end pairs remain real open rail ports; the centre contains a genuine open square between the routes. The common rail foot stays continuous below the channels. Nine newly drawn whole diagonal timbers have full ground soles and embedded finite rail seats. This is not the old three-port straight-plus-curving turnout given another branch, a road slab laid across one track, or two unmodified tracks superposed: no fixed point tie, route divergence or imported stock geometry is used. Four opaque constant PBR roles, metres native Z up, actual horizontal-envelope-centred ground datum. One whole modular prop, zero scenes. Invented fixed game-art dimensions only, not a manufactured crossing design. No continuous train or wheel passage, validated flange clearance, standard gauge, port compatibility, track-network fit, wheel loading, wear, switching, signaling, structural capacity, manufacture, installation or railway safety claim. Rigging animation and interaction not made or verified.
